text.aria-label: Title text 'Only B1 on cold nights at the six clearly beats its placebo. Dot: difference over 2 seeds (B3a, B4: 1 seed). Bar: Bonferroni (20 tests) month-block interval, near min-to-max with 5 months (3 for cold nights). Line at 0: same as placebo. Interim.'
text.tspan: Only B1 on cold nights at the six clearly beats its placebo. Dot: difference over
2 seeds (B3a, B4: 1 seed). Bar: Bonferroni (20 tests) month-block interval, near
min-to-max with 5 months (3 for cold nights). Line at 0: same as placebo. Interim.
